newsitem.title: ZAIRE: UNHCR says 500,000 Rwandan refugees now back.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR says 500,000 Rwandan refugees now back.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR said on Monday half a million Hutu refugees had now crossed back into Rwanda from Zaire.

"We are estimating at the moment that some half million people have crossed over. We now have a 60-km (38-mile) human caterpillar moving from Gisenyi to the other side of Ruhengeri," UNHCR spokesman Ray Wilkinson told reporters.
He said there were still pockets of refugees on the road west from Goma and several thousands still appeared to be on the way to the border.
But he said he had no reports of any movement by some 500,000 refugees in the Bukavu area on the south of Lake Kivu.
The refugees, Hutus who fled the arrival in power of a Tutsi-led movement in 1994, began returing last week after Zairean rebels forced Hutu fighters to flee to the hills.
